name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Breastplate
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Breastplate: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Battle gear gives you power in the tribe. The freethinkers are honored in this way. They are zealots. They imbue their breastplates with powerful mojo. If their beliefs falter in the face of the enemy, their breastplate will not.

You must be revered amongst us to possess such a breastplate. Go to Zul'Gurub. Take the Paragons of Power I need. Take the Paragons most painfully from the fools inside. Bring them to me. Prove your worth as a freethinker once and for all.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the Paragons? They have mojo inside them. We must have them. You will aid us.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done what few ever could. You have brought the minions of Hakkar to their knees. You have shown them what a freethinker can do. You have shown us how a heretic could be revered in the tribe. You have more than real power. You ARE real power.
Take the breastplate, freethinker. Crush those who oppose you.
